title: WeAudit: Scaffolding User Auditors and AI Practitioners in Auditing Generative AI
reasoning: The paper describes a system and workflow (WeAudit) specifically designed to evaluate and audit generative AI for ethical harms and biases. It explicitly includes 'religion' as one of the 'affected groups' within its auditing taxonomy and reporting portal, and it discusses the ethical implications of user-led auditing and compensation for 'invisible labor'.
